# True Seeing (`spells:true-seeing`)
**Level 6 [Divination](../magic-schools/divination.md)** | **Casting Time:** Action | **Range:** Touch
**Components:** V, S, M (mushroom powder worth 25+, GP, which the spell consumes) | **Duration:** 1 hour | **Classes:** [Bard](../classes/bard.md), [Cleric](../classes/cleric.md), [Sorcerer](../classes/sorcerer.md), [Warlock](../classes/warlock.md), [Wizard](../classes/wizard.md)

For the duration, the willing creature you touch has Truesight with a range of 120 feet.
